g.text: Deterministic Intent Pipeline • Cache-First Deduplication • AI-Assisted Routing • CRM Synchronization & Observability
Polls product usage data, detects PQL spikes,
Extracts apex corporate domain from email,
Checks if corporate domain has been enriched
within TTL cache window (prevents duplicate runs)
MISS: Enqueues record to Clay Waterfall
B2B Software) BEFORE invoking expensive LLM
Non-ICP leads bypass AI scoring stage;
routes to nurture sequence or logs silently
Validates schema bounds; falls back to
deterministic rule on hallucination or timeout
Creates or updates CRM record with score,
Tier 1: Creates urgent HubSpot task + alert
Records payload, evaluation score, route decision,
Catches API rate limits, provider downtimes;
writes failure trace to dead-letter queue
